notes: Names, IDs, family, tier/stage, Vigor/Power, and role tags are machine-controlled. The complete 96-card roster is active in the public browser prototype. Draft effect profiles cover all 96 cards deterministically and use roleTag as the per-card ability name, but those effects remain intentionally inactive in battle resolution until the balance-integration and human-playtest gate is completed. Final card-specific wording, art, and tournament balance remain later gates.
